title: Condition Addendum to Guaranteed-Program Appraisals — In-Place Home Resale
content:
**Condition addendum.** The appraisal charge on an In-Place Home Resale file under the Guaranteed Resale Program carries a condition-addendum addition, added to the package's appraisal fee into the appraisal sum. The condition-addendum addition follows the largest count of standards items any inspection on the file has found failing, which the appraiser reports on with the repairs made: 4 or more add 50.00, at least one but fewer than 4 add 25.00, and a file whose inspections found no failing item adds nothing.

Every inspection on the file counts — the initial inspection and each re-inspection — and the figure taken is the highest number of standards items failed recorded on any one of them.

| Largest count of failing items on any inspection of the file | Condition-addendum addition |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.00 |
| 1 to 3 | 25.00 |
| 4 or more | 50.00 |

## Points of reading (hypothetical files)

| Inspections on the file | Largest count | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| initial: 5 failing; re-inspection: 0 failing | 5 | 50.00 |
| initial: 2 failing; re-inspection: 3 failing | 3 | 25.00 |
| initial: passed (0) | 0 | 0.00 |
